attr.text:
Instead of melees 
taking the same tower,
M1 goes clockwise
from A,
M2 counterclockwise.

Melees stand near
the edge of the tower

Ranged DPS and 
healers pay attention
to who isn't baiting
and go clockwise or
counterclockwise
depending on priority.

Clockwise prio:
H1 > H2 > R1 > R2

That means H1 
always clockwise and 
R2 always counter.

Ranged/Healer stand
near the middle of the
tower

Tethers now spawn
on the tanks and
tower ranged.

Ranged/Healer that
baited north puddles
ALWAYS north-west

Ranged/Healer that
baited south puddles
ALWAYS north-east

Pre-positions not
necessary but shown
for clarity.
- Melees never have to go out with tether
- No confusion over who baits and where

In ecliptic stampede, tethers
always spawn on the players
closest to the middle of each
tower.

Apparently, a lot of tanks in PF
don't know that tether players 
need to be behind the two 
non-tether players in two-way.
Thank you for coming to my TED talk.
